lines: The number of triangles whose sides are of
integer lengths and whose perimeter is 15
working: Sides a ≤ b ≤ c and a + b + c = 15
Triangle rule: a + b > c, so {purple:c ≤ 7}
content.takeaway: Fix the {b:longest side} first. It is always less than half the perimeter.
